other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Case-study plant equipped with an on-site cogeneration system (palm-oil-fueled motor) producing electricity 24/7
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
The plant object of the 
present study is provided with a cogeneration system (a 
motor fueled with palm oil) and is connected to the 
electricity grid

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Cogeneration system responsible for energy produced, with continuous production affected by functioning hours and maintenance
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
The third one is responsible for the availability 
and efficiency of the cogeneration system, therefore is 
connected to the amount of energy produced

one_line: Methodology for decomposing energy-budget variance applied to an energy-intensive Italian consumer-goods manufacturing plant that has an on-site palm-oil cogeneration system; the manufacturing itself is not a listed continuous-flow sector, but the on-site cogeneration is a recorded continuous-power signal.
